title: Semester and Recipe
author: Emrys Quintana
blurb: Ada Okafor, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
